verdict.rationale: Formant documents the data-collection half of the loop. Its Python Cloud SDK is described as the primary way data scientists query and export telemetry (formant-docs-3, formant-docs-56), and it offers time-synced video, sensor and intervention records (formant-docs-13), which could feed external model training. Nothing in the evidence documents a training integration or a model deployment / OTA path back to the fleet; a generic `formant.run_script` command (formant-docs-54) is only a building block for that. Missing for 10: native or documented integration with ML training pipelines, model versioning and fleet-wide model deployment or rollout, end-to-end data-to-model loop documentation, and independent corroboration.
